subject: iceCreamCart

I'm planning out a stylized ice cream vending cart module using blocky primitives: a tricycle-style cart with striped canopy, box body with serving window, freezer top, wheels, and a sign featuring an ice cream cone, all centered at origin with +Y up and +Z facing forward.

I'm setting up a root joint named "cart" at the origin to attach all the parts, then thinking through how to apply a striped paint pattern on the canopy using the stripes helper with a chosen axis so the bands run correctly across its surface.

For the ice cream details, I'm planning to use simple sphere geometries for the scoops in flavors like pink strawberry, mint, and chocolate, topped with a cherry sphere, keeping shapes basic (boxes, cylinders, spheres) rather than complex lathes, and attaching everything to the single root joint since there's only one bone to weight against.

Working out half-cylinder rotation math for the canopy arch...

I'm also planning a push handle at the rear made from two curved rods connecting the body to a bar, so the stand can be wheeled around like a cart.

For wheels, I'm placing two cylindrical wheels at the sides with darker hubs, rotated to lay flat against the body.

Adding small front casters for stability, and then thinking about decoration: stripes on the canopy in red/cream, plus maybe an "ICE CREAM" sign texture on the front panel.

For the sign, I'll place a small plane with a texture above the window, and reconsider the body's vertical proportions so the sign, window, and canopy all fit cleanly without overlapping — making the body a bit taller to give the sign band enough room.

For the sign topper, I'm sketching an ice cream cone shape above the canopy — a cone tapering upward with a scoop sitting on top, figuring out heights and radii so the scoop nests snugly on the cone's base.

I'm working out the surface patterns for the cone (a waffle texture) and scoops (sprinkle-like spots), then adding sign decoration: a chalkboard menu panel on the body's side and a front header sign, both using SVG textures for stylized "ICE CREAM" graphics and simple cone/scoop illustrations.

Now I'm planning the overall rig structure — defining the root joint, writing a box-creation helper, and placing the handle rods, wheel hubs, front casters, and axle supports with their positions and radii so the cart frame holds together physically.

I'm finalizing paint definitions for the scoops and cone (spots and patches patterns with specific colors and sizes) and nailing down the body's window, counter, and sign placements so they don't awkwardly overlap, adjusting z-depths and heights until everything lines up front-to-back.
